notes.title: Everdream Valley – fixes to the most common issues are here!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Everdreamers, 
A new update is here, focusing on the issues and suggestions you brought up lately! [/h3]

[h3]Let’s jump straight into the changelog: [/h3]

💩[b]Poop Cleanup Made Easier[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now auto-collect poop by running over it with a basket (larger pickup radius than other items)
[*] If left untouched, it disappears after 1 in-game day, fertilizing the ground and increasing grass growth by 20%
[/list]
🎵 [b]Audio Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Cutscene cameras now properly disable environmental audio (e.g., no bee buzzing when not around)
[/list]
🏆 [b]Achievement Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Butterfly hunter, Little lumberjack, Super lumberjack, Treasure hunter, Animal Friend achievements now unlock properly in multiplayer mode
[/list]
🌟 [b]Gameplay Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Basket Auto-Collect Fix – Items are now properly collected even when running fast through dense fields
[*] Autosave in Cooking – Now triggers at the end of cooking to prevent lag spikes
[*] Butterfly Collection Quest – Merchant dialogue improved for clarity; the player returning with all four butterflies must have them in their inventory. Butterflies in other players’ inventory will not count
[/list]
🪲 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Duck Overpopulation – Fixed issue where picking up or placing ducks near the snail hunting station would duplicate them
[*] Hose Repairs – Hose repairing is now working properly in multiplayer. Additionally, both players can see that a hose is damaged
[*] Fishing Zones – Fish no longer swim into rocks
[*] Hay Rack – works properly and doesn’t reset when under a roof
[*] Magpie Synchronization – Fixed desync issue where the magpie’s flight path differed for each player
[*] Lobby Name Reset – Fixed issue where the lobby name would reset unexpectedly
[*] Localization Fix – Standardized Polish translation for "bison" (previously inconsistently translated as "żubr" and "bizon")
[*] Friend’s Game Freezing – Investigated frequent game freezes requiring force quit; performance improvements applied
[/list]

[h3]Now, go enjoy the update!
May your farm be cozy, your animals happy, and your grass… well, 20% greener. 🌱[/h3]

notes.title: Multiplayer Patch is now out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/cedb21e199a99db87656350d33452d640dcb3f2c.png[/img]

Howdy Everdreamers!

We're walking on over with exciting updates to enhance your Everdream Valley experience!

[b]Performance Polish:[/b] Our team has been busy buffing the game's physics and camera systems, ensuring smoother gameplay for all you dedicated farmers. Load times have also been optimized, so you can get back to your fields in a jiffy!

[b]Global Greetings![/b] A warm welcome to our new players from Japan and Taiwan! Everdream Valley now supports both Japanese and Traditional Chinese languages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38622168/66e6e02a3fdce0a58c23410bf404583bff82cc19.png[/img]

So to not to keep you waiting, let's get to the patch notes right away!

[u][b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Owls - your new best friends! They will protect you from mice but they will also help you out with travels! Get 2 owls and you’ll be able to fast travel between their locations! If you have only one owl you will travel back to the farm.
[*] A new breed of sheep will appear in your Valley.
[*] Cutting grass with a sword is fun, but not that effective. Show the grass who’s the boss with the brand new Lawnmower!

[*] nsect House added - this building will allow you to breed insects - max. 10 per house! Time to relocate? Feel free to catch them with your Bug Net!
[*] Bird House added – Friendly birds will now visit this brand-new building, and in return for the house - they will reward you with various seeds!
[*] Scared of bees? Use the brand-new Turbo Bee Smoker to scare them away for a longer time! 
[*] Added 9 new delicious cooking recipes, yum.
[*] The price of products has been changed, ensuring a better economy.
[*] Added two more saddles for your horses! Enjoy it in green and orange colors. 
[*] You can now build a bonfire which will help you out with keeping the wolves at a distance!
[/list]

notes.title: Everdream Valley's Spooky Scarecrow Speaks! 🌾
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there Farmers, 
it’s the Scarecrow from Everdream Valley here!🌾[/h3] 

You do know me, right? 
I stand there on the farm all year, waiting for [b]THIS DAY[/b] to come. 
🌃 🌇 🌆

Oh, how I love the [b]Spooky Season[/b], and now I get to celebrate it on the farm with all of you! 
This means that… 

🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃   [h3][u][b]THE HALLOWEEN EVENT IS HERE![/b][/u][/h3] 🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃🎃

Yes, yes, yes! 
Look at the colors of the world now, a beautiful golden-toned fall. 
Oh, and some of my friends are joining the farm now. Yay! 

🎃 So all of the fully-grown pumpkins will now turn into [b]Jack-o'-lanterns[/b]! 
🕷️ Also, some [b]eight-legged creatures[/b] are very active during this time. Kick a stone – they’re there, get near some places – they will also be there! I believe humans call them [b]Spiders[/b], I call them fluffy friends with cute eyes. 🕸️
🦇 You’ll also have a chance to spot some majestic [b]Bats[/b], I love the sound of their wings, ahh!

Additionally, I have a pact with wolves during this time of year that you should know about. 
Once all of my team joins the Valley, I send the wolves to go on vacation! 🐺 🌴 ☀️
This way you’re free to explore the land without them chasing you off, you’re welcome :D

You’ll also bump into me right away once you launch the game, and we’ll have a chat about what’s happening in Everdream Valley. [b]I might have a task or two for you… [/b]
But remember, Scarecrows always hold some great rewards for your work. So it will pay off! 

[b]And a few important notices for you, Farmers: [/b]
- if you’re [b]not a fan of Spiders[/b] like I am – you can go to the game's options and [b]turn them into ladybugs![/b] 
- if you [b]do not like my kind of fall coziness, as in the Halloween Event [/b]– you can also [b]turn it off over in the options
[/b]

Have a spooktacular time, Farmers! 
I know I will! 🎃🕯️

[b]P.S. For those who do not like to read between the lines here are the Halloween Event patch notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] All ripe pumpkins now transform into enchanting custom Halloween models, embracing the spooky spirit!
[*] Kick a stone, and out come the spiders, ready to give you a fright, every single time!
[*] Spiders creep out from under big trees, the corners of buildings, and even the kitchen when you get up close. Watch your step!
[*] When night falls, bats flutter about in random spots, adding a touch of mystique to your valley adventure.
[*] During the event, we've given wolves a break, so you can explore the valley under the starry night sky.
[*] We've turned up the autumn vibes, setting the perfect mood with cozy, warm lighting in the game.
[*] Trees now paint the valley with yellow, orange, and red hues, adding to the autumn charm.
[*] Added a new Halloween-themed Quest 
[*] Added rewards for completing the Halloween-themed Quest
[*] Halloween event rewards will stay in the game forever, and can be found under the rocks or at the Merchant’s store! 
[*] You can choose to disable all Halloween-themed content in the gameplay options 
[*] Arachnophobia mode can be set in the gameplay options, turning spiders into ladybugs
[/list]

notes.title: 📝Everdream Valley Update 1.5 Patch Notes 📝
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Farmers,[/h3]

[b]Oink-oink, it's me, Peter Curleytail! [/b]
I'm absolutely thrilled to share some exciting news from the Everdream Valley team! We've got a brand new update that's all about making your farming experience even better. So, gather 'round, and let me fill you in on the details! 🐷

This update focuses on fixing those pesky bugs and sprinkling in a few Quality of Life enhancements to make your time in Everdream Valley truly magical. But hold onto your straw hats, because there are even bigger updates in the pipeline, and they're filled with all sorts of fantastic surprises! 🎉


[u][b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Take charge of your save files with a new option that lets you delete them when needed. It's all about putting you in control of your Everdream Valley journey.
[*] Custom Map Markers: Navigate with flair using six different marker colors.
[*] Geese are now gentler with a bite stun duration cut in half. Fear the bite no more with this shorter geese bite stun.
[*] After a goose bite, the hurt state is now temporary, lasting for 2 minutes. Swiftly recover from a nip and continue your farming quests.
[*] Unveiling three additional chest colors with separate storage. Organize like never before!
[*] Become a Chef! Unlock instant cooking after flawlessly preparing each recipe 10 times. Your expertise in the kitchen will lead to newfound culinary efficiency.
[*] Strengthen your connections with your beloved cat and dog. Their friendship and training levels now decrease at a rate five times slower.
[*] After completing a few quests strawberries, pumpkins, and potatoes will be available at the Merchant’s store, enhancing your farming palette with fresh produce.
[*] Delight in a refined cat mini-game with longer intervals between hoops and a more responsive feline friend.
[*] Animals are more considerate now, with an 80% reduction in poop. Enjoy a cleaner and more enjoyable farming experience.
[*] Watch in awe as goats display newfound agility, jumping on objects like hay cubes and tables. Your farm will come alive with their antics.
[*] Adult pigs now passively generate truffles, matching cows' milk-giving generosity. Your farm's treasure trove is about to get tastier.
[*] Additionally to the automatically generated truffles, you will now earn them while riding the adult pig! 
[/list]

[u][b]Controls and options:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Tailor your gameplay to your preferences with rebindable gamepad controls, ensuring Everdream Valley suits your playstyle.
[*] Stay immersed in the serenity of the valley with the new calm horse camera option. 
[*] Play in perfect lighting conditions with the newly added screen brightness option. Let the valley's charm shine as it should.
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] We've taken steps to address corrupted save files, alleviating the issue for many players. Your progress should now be more secure.
[*] We've fine-tuned quests involving ducks and sheep, ensuring smooth progression and preventing early completion.
[*] Mirrors reflect reality better now, with grass becoming visible. Your mirror will showcase your farm's beauty accurately.
[*] Minor fixes.
[/list]


Minor fixes and adjustments have also been woven into this patch to ensure a seamless and immersive farming adventure. Thank you for your dedication, feedback, and enthusiasm that keep Everdream Valley thriving.

Embrace the magic and nurture your dreams as you embark on checking this update out!

[i]With love and snuggles,
Peter Curleytail[/i] 🐽💕

notes.title: 📝Everdream Valley Update 1.3 Patch Notes 📝
notes.content:
[h3]🌳🌻Greetings, lovely farmers of Everdream Valley!🌳🌻[/h3]

We're back with an exciting update filled with enhancements and fixes to make your farming experience even more delightful. 🌾✨

[u][b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Unlock the joy of riding a horse by obtaining a saddle in the game. Saddle up and embark on exciting adventures across the beautiful landscapes of Everdream Valley. There’s no need to worry about winning the Horse Race Dream anymore! 
[*] Geese will no longer attack players if a dog is nearby. Enjoy a harmonious atmosphere on your farm as your faithful four-legged friend keeps the geese at bay.
[*] Animal Treat Station: Your animal companions will now happily munch on snails if you place them into the animal treat station. 
[*] Increased hitboxes for perches in the Chicken Dream, allowing your feathered friends to land more accurately and effortlessly.
[*] Completing the scarecrow quest now grants you a pumpkin and strawberry, adding a touch of flavor and variety to your farming endeavors. Make sure to plant them, to grow even more of these delicious fruits and veggies!
[*] Animals will now also hide in the barn when looking for a dry place to run to from the rain. 
[*] We've optimized memory usage while placing fences, resulting in smoother performance and enhanced gameplay.
[*] Furniture will now have their reflections visible in mirrors! 
[*] We’ve added an End Game dialogue, informing our Farmers that they’ve completed the story.
[/list]

[u][b]User Interface Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Inventory & Storage Sorting: Stay organized and efficient with the brand-new sorting feature for your inventory and storage. Easily arrange items based on your preferred criteria such as their price, quantity, type, or name.
[*] Dialogue Logs: Keep track of your conversations and interactions. The new dialogue log feature allows you to review previous conversations and revisit important details. You can find them under the ‘Tab’ button!
[*] We’ve added an ‘unequip’ button for items held in your hands.
[*] If you’re playing on a controller there will be no ‘F2’ button in the game options for the UI hiding button. You’ll see a button that’s right for your pad! 
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] We've conducted a thorough check to ensure that goats hiding under rocks don't get stuck and get teleported over to the Merchant. 
[*] Contaminated Pond Quest should work properly now.
[*] The scarecrow's feather has received a visual upgrade. It now features a two-sided material, enhancing its realistic appearance. 
[*] You can now place the picked up well back in its original spot.
[*] We've fixed an issue where items placed on the treehouse walls couldn't be picked up properly. Now, you can easily rearrange your treehouse décor to your heart's content.
[*] The map icons for the chicken house, kitchen and workshop have been fixed ensuring easy navigation and a clear understanding of each location's purpose.
[*] The magnifying glass material has been adjusted to ensure it displays correctly from all angles. Enjoy a clearer view as you investigate the wonders of Everdream Valley.
[*] Chickens should now hop into their perches without any issues.
[*] Animals will no longer hide from rain underneath dry trees.
[*] After loading a saved game, chickens will now stay in the perches they’ve been sitting on while saving.
[*] We've made some adjustments to optimize the display settings for the Steam Deck. Say goodbye to setting the wrong display size and enjoy Everdream Valley in fullscreen mode.
[*] Animals will not sit on top of each other during rainy weather. Their positions will be a bit more randomized. 
[*] Finishing the cow quest will now be giving an empty jug instead of one filled with milk.
[/list]

Let us know how do you like it, perhaps leave us a review, and have another great day in the Valley! 🌾✨

notes.title: Q&A with Peter Curleytail 🐷 ❓
notes.content:
[h2]🐷 Oink, oink! 🐷[/h2]

Greetings, fellow gamers and Steam enthusiasts! It's me, Peter the Pig, here to answer some of the most frequently asked questions trotting around the community regarding our life on the farm. So without further ado, let's dive right into them!

[h3][b]Why do some chicken names disappear by themselves after a few days?[/b][/h3]
[i]This was an issue, and the team has already resolved it! Your chicken’s names should stay in place now.[/i]

[h3][b]Why do the chickens wander off outside the farm when there are grass and hay bales around?[/b][/h3]
[i]Maybe the dog accidentally chased them away? Perhaps it was raining and they were looking for a place to hide? Or they just wanted to go for a walk, they are living animals after all… :) [/i]

[h3][b]What does the total of chicken number mean? For example, it may display Total number of chicken: 12, but the total number in coop is 9. But i don't have any other chicken icons on my map.[/b][/h3]
[i]Trust us - there are 3 more chickens somewhere on the map! :)[/i]

[h3][b]How near or how far apart must the chicken perches be spaced to register as legitimate perches?[/b][/h3]
[i]There is no special distance. It has to be just big enough so that the chicken is able to squeeze into the perch.[/i]

[h3][b]Why does Grandma get stuck in the animal pens that she managed to get into?[/b][/h3]
[i]Check if your fence has any holes in it! If so, then fix it, and this should not be happening :)[/i]

[h3][b]What do ducks eat other than snails?[/b][/h3]
[i]Ducks like to munch on some grass too! [/i]

[h3][b]Why did my trained dog run to the northern island when i went to find the entertaining goats?[/b][/h3]
[i]Perhaps you took a strange route through for example some rocks, which the dog couldn’t climb? Our friend might get lost sometimes, when he cannot find a safe path to go through. [/i]

[h3][b]Are there specific fishing spots? Or we can only catch fish at the pond for the fishing contest?[/b][/h3]
[i]In some of the spots you can see the fish in the water. This means it’s a great place to catch them! [/i]

[h3][b]How do I ride a horse? [/b][/h3]
[i]You need to win a Horse Race Dream! This will unlock a Saddle, which you’ll be able to purchase from the Merchant. [/i]

[h3][b]How do we select one unit of an item/vegetable?[/b][/h3]
[i]There’s no such feature yet, but we’ve added it to our suggestions list! [/i]


That’s all for today folks! 

If you have any more questions or need further advice, don't hesitate to oink at me. 

[h3]Happy gaming, and may your adventures be as fun as mud baths are for me! 🐷🎮[/h3]

notes.title: 📝Everdream Valley Update 1.2 Patch Notes 📝
notes.content:
[h3][b]🌳🌻Greetings, dedicated farmers of Everdream Valley!🌳🌻[/b][/h3]

We've been hard at work tending to the enchanting fields and carefully listening to your valuable feedback. Today, we're thrilled to present yet another patch, filled with exciting improvements and fixes that will make your farming journey even better!

Here we go with the patch notes! 

[h3][u][b]Two fresh additions: [/b][/u][/h3]

Starting out with some cosmetics, you get new pants! 
And moving on to… [b]A MAGIC FLUTE! 🎶✨[/b]
Once you play it the animals get charmed by its beautiful sound, and will start following you anywhere! Try it on a group of animals, or make it a private concert for just one furry friend. 
Oh, and feel free to play it while riding on your horse too! 
The animals will keep on following you, until you play them a song once more. After playing the song again they will stop following you.
How to get the Magic Flute? Simply complete the “Bring Ducks” quest, and it should appear on the Merchant’s shopping list! 

[h3][u][b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b][/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Put your creative skills to the test! You can now rotate objects before placing them on your farm, allowing for more precise positioning and customization.
[*] You can now experience the ultimate relaxation by sleeping on a cozy treehouse bed. Climb up and let the soothing ambiance of nature lull you into a restful slumber.
[*] Your shopping list is now more reliable than ever! It will stay in the same position even after buying or selling an item, making your shopping experience seamless and organized.
[*] Beavers have decided to take things a bit slower. They will now move at a 30% reduced speed, embracing a more relaxed pace.
[*] We've introduced a new splash label for autosaves, you won’t miss these important checkpoints in your farming journey now.
[*] To enhance your exploration experience, we've added a map icon specifically for tents. No more lost tents!
[*] We've adjusted the snails' eating pace, making them savor their meals four times longer than before.
[*] We've lowered the sound volume for sprinklers, watering cans, and bottles. Now you can tend to your crops without disturbing the tranquility of the valley.
[*] You can now change the names of your two loyal farm friends: dog and cat! 
[*] Say goodbye to the ‘Aramis’ default name for the adorable cat! 
[*] You will now get grass seeds while cutting grass with your sword! Yes, the very basic grass seeds that all Farmers need! Perfect for hay! 
[*] When you win a horse race, you will now get a pop-up with rewards that will now be automatically added to the shop, unlocking a new saddle for your companion.
[*] We've made some adjustments to the prices of saddles and Shakshuka, ensuring that they are balanced and in line with the value they bring to your farming endeavors. The saddle costs 2000 coins and the Shakshuka 300!

notes.content:

[*] We've added missing keyboard keys to the list of possible rebind options, including Del, Page Up/Down, and more.
[*] Completing the "Clean the Pond" quest just got smoother. Task 2 will now unlock promptly after completing Task 1, ensuring a more streamlined quest progression.

[*] The photo camera's focus red tint will no longer get stuck on animals, ensuring your captured memories are picture-perfect.

[*] The Avatar Editor has been fixed, addressing the issue of input lock after exiting the clothes editor with any clothing selected. You can now express your unique style without any problems!

[*] For those who prefer to run, we've introduced a run toggle option. Now you can explore the valley at a brisk pace without holding down the sprint button.

[*] The saw minigame can also be completed instantly, offering one wood.

[*] In the goat, horse, and firefly dream games, the rewards will now be displayed in the finishing window, adding clarity and excitement to your accomplishments.
[/list]

notes.content:
[h3]Dear Farmers,[/h3]

We want to express our sincere gratitude to all of you for your support, feedback, reports, and suggestions. [b]Your contribution has been invaluable to the development of Everdream Valley.[/b] We've been hard at work addressing various issues and improving the gameplay experience. 
Here is the list of bug fixes and improvements:


[h3][u][b]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b][/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] Geese and sheep will no longer appear underneath rocks. We have addressed this issue, allowing these animals to spawn in appropriate locations.
[*] Improved animal spawn behavior after purchasing from the vendor. Animals will no longer spawn within the ground.
[*] The goat dream game has been fixed to prevent doubling rewards before the finish window, ensuring fair gameplay and consistent rewards.
[*] The issue causing the game to freeze after the chicken dream has been resolved. You can now proceed without any interruptions.
[*] Fixed an issue where purchased insects, such as bees or fireflies, were spawning at the shop's farm instead of being added to the player's inventory. They will now correctly go into the inventory upon purchase. 
[*] The framerate issue in the loading screen has been fixed, providing a smoother transition into the game.
[*] Implemented a fix where players will now receive a butterfly book as a gift from Grandpa. This reward will be triggered upon initiating the 'Butterflies for Merchant' quest. Engage in a conversation with Grandpa to ensure you receive this special gift. Happy butterfly collecting!
[*] Some players may have already progressed beyond the 'Butterflies for Merchant' quest. If you have surpassed this quest and did not receive the book from Grandpa, worry not! Upon loading your save, the Butterfly Book will now be available for purchase from the Merchant's inventory.
[*] Various minor bug fixes.
[/list]


[h3][u][b]Gameplay and Cooking Experience tweaks:[/b][/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] Cooking difficulty level has been tweaked to be less punishing, ensuring a more enjoyable culinary experience for all players.
[*] A cooking color score legend has been added to provide a better understanding of your cooking performance.
[*] We have introduced a new option called "Polite Wolves Mode." When enabled, wolves will exhibit more polite behavior. They will howl more quietly, and there will be no emission of glowing eyes. Hopefully this will keep our adventurers more relaxed at night.
[*] In the first dream with wolves they will be more polite, ensuring a cozier experience. 
[*] When creating a new character, a notification will prompt players to enter a name if left blank, ensuring a smoother character creation process.
[*] Sprinkler frequency has been adjusted. Sprinklers will now work for 10 minutes every hour instead of operating continuously, offering a more balanced watering system.
[*] Players can now lift the chicken coop by holding the interaction button, rather than requiring a single press. Additionally, the chicken coop can no longer be destroyed, ensuring its durability.
[*] Players can now lift the haystack by holding the interaction button, rather than requiring a single press.
[*] Players can now lift the saw by holding the interaction button, rather than requiring a single press.
[*] Players now start with a recipe for a rope, allowing for immediate crafting possibilities.
[*] The FPS counter has been removed from the user interface to reduce clutter and enhance the immersive experience.
[*] Roosters have been improved to wake up earlier, at 8 o'clock, when present on the farm. Enjoy their timely wake-up calls!
[/list]


We hope that these changes will enhance your gameplay experience in Everdream Valley. We deeply appreciate your continued support, and we're excited to provide you with an even better gaming experience. Stay tuned for more updates and keep sharing your valuable feedback with us!

Sincerely,

The Everdream Valley Development Team

notes.title: Sleeping animals
notes.content:
Our farm is a beautiful sunny place full of lively animals!

But soon the sun sets on the farm and the eyelids get heavy. After an active and adventurous day comes the night! We wanted to make farm life always interesting and attractive so we made sure that there are also some attractions while the moon is up!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38622168/b96dff262986c4b7b3603b32c6efe9324e94e06a.png[/img]

[h3]Magic dreams![/h3]

You can try your luck at the [b]dream lottery [/b]where unexpected rewards await you.
But an even stranger phenomenon occur: spirits roam free from their bodies in the realm of dreams, and [b]you can get to play as the animals of the farm[/b]! Protect the flock against wolves with the dog, and discover how it is like to be the good boi protecting the household! Nights are full of wonders and they can be as exciting as shiny days.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38622168/c27d0782083f9855ac420c57a684bf67f1c6117c.png[/img]

[h3]Sleeping beauty[/h3]

And if you want to relax before going to sleep, our farm is surrounded by peacefully dreaming, sighting and snoring animals. It can be sheep, baby ducks or our latest star - Peter Curleytail, who makes sure to snore the loudest of them all (the best ASMR in the whole valley)!

Here are some pictures of our cosy family that sleeps peacefully and dreams of the adventures that are yet to come!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38622168/83bde185f771ea4f58c08e1ba2d4f465170fb5b8.png[/img]

Good night, and see you next time!

Hit us with your feather balls on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/jWsywT9MH4]Discord[/url], or tag us on [url=https://twitter.com/EverdreamValley]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/everdreamvalleygame/]Instagram[/url] or [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@everdream.valley]TikTok[/url], we hope it will help to get to know each other!
